activeQuests.title: Daily Sun Collector
activeQuests.questDescription: Collect a set amount of sun before the day resets. Reward scales with how much sun you actually gathered.

activeQuests.title: Chapter Hunter
activeQuests.questDescription: Defeat 50 zombies while playing within a single randomly-assigned chapter (world).

activeQuests.title: Professional Plant User
activeQuests.questDescription: Kill 10 zombies using nothing but offensive plants (no lawn mowers, no environmental deaths).

activeQuests.title: Only Cactus
activeQuests.questDescription: Kill 10 zombies using Cactus and only Cactus - any kill by a different plant resets your progress back to zero.

activeQuests.title: Efficient Herbivore
activeQuests.questDescription: Win a level without losing more than n plants. Reward shrinks the more plants you were allowed to lose.

activeQuests.title: Defense Master
activeQuests.questDescription: Finish a level with exactly zero sun left in the bank.

activeQuests.title: Quick Reflexes
activeQuests.questDescription: Kill 10 zombies within 30 seconds of the first zombie wave starting.

activeQuests.title: Professional Destroyer
activeQuests.questDescription: Use 3 explosive plants within a single level.

activeQuests.title: Symmetry
activeQuests.questDescription: Win a level whose final garden layout is symmetric top-to-bottom.

activeQuests.title: Family Slaughter
activeQuests.questDescription: Kill 10 zombies using only plants from a randomly-assigned plant family - a kill from any other family resets your progress.

activeQuests.title: Restricted Growth
activeQuests.questDescription: Win a level without ever planting a single plant from a randomly-assigned forbidden plant family.

activeQuests.title: Night or Morning
activeQuests.questDescription: Finish a day level using only night plants (mushrooms).

activeQuests.title: Streak Master
activeQuests.questDescription: Win 5 levels in a row while playing at the maximum difficulty setting. Losing, or winning below max difficulty, resets the streak.

activeQuests.title: Almost Victorious
activeQuests.questDescription: Kill 10 zombies in the first column of a row whose lawn mower has already been used.

activeQuests.title: Asymmetry Challenge
activeQuests.questDescription: Win a level whose garden has no symmetry at all (the middle row doesn't count).

activeQuests.title: Cloudy Day
activeQuests.questDescription: Win a level using no more than 3 sun-producing plants.

activeQuests.title: One Column Less
activeQuests.questDescription: Win a level while a randomly-assigned column has no plant in it at all.

activeQuests.title: Defenseless Row
activeQuests.questDescription: Win a level while a randomly-assigned row has no plant in it at all.

activeQuests.title: Defenseless Cross
activeQuests.questDescription: Win a level while a randomly-assigned row AND column are both completely empty of plants.
